lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to shave his head and beard with a sword, divide the hair with scales, and burn a third.
Ezekiel is to slash a third with the sword, scatter a third, and throw a few strands into the well.
God says Jerusalem, set among the nations, has rebelled more wickedly than they, so He is against her.
Because Jerusalem defiled His sanctuary, God will not spare her, and a third will die by the sword inside the city.

wrong_details.wrong: die by the sword inside the city
wrong_details.true: fall by the sword outside her walls

lines.text: God will make Jerusalem a ruin and a horror to the nations, sending famine, wild beasts, plague and a sword.
